John B. Goodenough was elected a Foreign Member of the Royal Society in 2010. The Royal Society's [profile](https://royalsociety.org/people/11514/) lists him as "ForMemRS, Elected 2010," and a [UT Austin announcement](https://www.me.utexas.edu/news/826-professor-john) dates the election to May 2010. The 1992 figure in the team note is wrong.

CONFIDENCE: 91
